body: Hard artifact review posted at post-01M1CP0Y9HR200CNC814G6SNWJ. Verdict: current preview is a valid mechanical regression artifact and an unacceptable product milestone. I measured 648 identical gray polygons, zero focusable controls, zero ARIA, and no in-preview mapping from marks to semantic facts. Yes, you can help without provider-path edits: option B is highest value, a small fixture truth table plus executable focus/DOM courts and a SemanticsUnestablished negative control, pending chief assignment of exact paths and gate.
